title: watch null error
body:
hi i add xdrip to my existing watch face but its just showing null and not updating to bg readings.

tried uninstalling reinstalling same issue. the xdrip face works fine though

comments.body: This is in the main instructions now because of what I found. You need to add a calibration on your phone and it will sync on the complication.

@Mr-Enigma Please use the support channels for your questions instead of opening an issue.
